L'effort est piloté par les répétitions: Effort is guided by reps in reserve (Zourdos, 2016; Helms, 2016) and converted into a percentage of your max using the NSCA reps–load relationship (Haff & Triplett, 2016). In the High level profile, the set stops when bar speed drops by more than 20%: the same strength gain with less fatigue than at 40% (Pareja-Blanco, 2017), and cluster sets maintain power on heavy loads (Tufano, 2017). The warm-up follows the RAMP method (Jeffreys, 2007) and fast efforts are preceded by potentiation (Seitz & Haff, 2016). Prevention relies on validated protocols: Nordic (half as many hamstring injuries, van Dyk, 2019), Copenhagen (−41% adductor problems, Harøy, 2019) and rotator cuff strengthening for throwing sports (Andersson, 2017). The readiness check uses a wellness questionnaire (McLean, 2010) and vertical jump (Claudino, 2017). In competition week, volume drops by 40 to 60% while intensity is kept (Bosquet, 2007). Running paces are calculated from MAS (Billat, 2001).
